newsitem.title: CHILE: Codelco divisions report no problems due to storm.
newsitem.headline: Codelco divisions report no problems due to storm.

text.p: Two divisions of Chile's state copper company Codelco, Andina and El Teniente, said Monday they had not been hampered by the severe storms that hit the country's central region.
Rodrigo Rivas of El Teniente and Antonio Varas of Andina said activity was normal in their units despite the bad weather, which cut off roads and communications in vast areas of the region.

Since Saturday, Chilean authorities have closed the ports of Valparaiso, San Antonio, Quintana, Talcahuano, Lirquen and Coquimbo, expecting them to stay shut until weather improves on Tuesday or Wednesday.
Calls to Codelco's Salvador division did not get through, apparently because the storm affected telephone lines. The rains had also affected roads to the port of Huasco, which services that unit.
An official at Codelco's head offices in Santiago said the corporation would have a report on the status of the divisions later on Monday.
